propositions: PASS-path reuse (idempotent_reuse) synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, losing advisory findings from the last actual review.
BLOCK-path reuse (verdict_reuse) correctly replays stored blocking/advisory/coaching from the latest sidecar with reused notation, establishing the desired shape.

When plan review skips re-running due to unchanged plan state, the CLI notation must clearly indicate the output is the last review's result replayed, not a fresh LLM run, and must include recency anchors (verified_at_sha/timestamp) from the sidecar when available.

The PASS reuse path must read the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar and populate advisory/coaching/indeterminate/coverage.counts from stored result when sidecar is valid and matches the material fingerprint, while preserving fail-open behavior (unreadable/absent/mismatched sidecar degrades to empty lists; attestation remains validity authority).
Both reuse paths must emit coverage.replayed_review with recency anchors and maintain existing coverage.llm_ran=False and idempotent_skip/verdict_reuse flags in machine-readable output.
CLI notation must remain valid under MCP output schema validation and include --force pointer to enable re-review when staleness is a concern.
